documents.title: SOP: VWR SympHony B10P pH Meter

steps.action: Switch on the pH meter with the power button and wait about 10 seconds for initialization.
Prepare the three reference buffers for recalibration (pH 4.00, pH 7.00 and pH 10.00) using the reusable buffers in the 50 mL conical tubes.
Remove the probe from the storage solution, rinse it with Millipore water, dry it with a Kimwipe, place it in the pH 4.00 buffer, click read and wait for the stable icon.
Rinse the probe with Millipore water, place it in the pH 7.00 buffer, click read and wait for the stable icon.
Rinse the probe with Millipore water, place it in the pH 10.00 buffer, click read and wait for the stable icon.
Check that each calibration reading is within 0.01 pH of the buffer value (for example 3.99, 4.00 or 4.01 for the pH 4.00 buffer) before continuing.
Place the clean probe in the sample solution and click read; rinse the probe with Millipore water before and after each reading.
Switch off the meter, clean up spills, rinse the probe and return it to the storage solution so that the solution covers the probe.
Switch on the balance with the On/Off button and wait for the initial calibration (about 30 seconds) to finish.
With nothing on the weighing pan, press 0/Delete to zero the balance.
Check the weighing unit (default grams, four decimal places); change it with Units/Esc only if needed.
Place the weighing paper or boat on the pan and press T/Insert to tare.
Add the reagent slowly with a spatula through the side doors, keeping the top door closed, then close the side doors; clean spills with a Kimwipe.
Press On/Off to return the balance to sleep mode and clean remaining spills with a Kimwipe sprayed with 70% ethanol.
